decisions.rationale: The parser copies ZHB-tipinfo raw column [11] into `forecast_date_recent`. The retained-archive audit checks 84815 pairs across 15 date-named archives with zero mismatches; all non-empty values are 8-digit date strings. The verified same-source raw anchor supplies the field meaning and unit. Official TdxQuant documentation lists `NoticeDate_Recent` as “最近业绩预告日”, which corroborates the semantic label. This decision verifies only the ZHB runtime alias to its raw column; it does not assert a cross-source value mapping to a separate TDX API response.
